BiblicalUsage: Goah is a place near Jerusalem, named once in Jeremiah's picture of the restored city. It stands in Jeremiah 31:39, in the measuring line of the restored Jerusalem.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Goah matters because God's story happened in real places, and Goah is one of them.
